description: Shapes shared between designs — decks, lists and snapshots.

designEntry.description: A card a design refers to, owned or not. Identity is (oracleId, scryfallId, finish).

oracleId.description: Scryfall oracle id: the card, not a printing.

scryfallId.description: Scryfall print id, when the printing is deliberate. Absent means any printing.

section.description: Which part of the deck. Absent means main; lists ignore it.

visibility.description: Whether this AppView surfaces the record. Not access control: atproto records are publicly fetchable regardless. Absent means unlisted.

forkRef.description: Where a design was forked from.

source.description: The design forked from; the cid pins the version.

snapshot.description: The snapshot forked from, when it wasn't current state.

change.description: One invertible edit to a design's entries.

entry.description: The entry after the change, with its resulting quantity.

previousQuantity.description: Quantity before the change; what makes the edit invertible.
